trust_decision.summary: Which User fields leave the server is decided by the JSON tags on the shared model.User struct. AccessToken (the panel-management bearer credential) is tagged json:"access_token", so any admin-only route that serializes a User, including the root user in list/search results, returns it. Separately, the role-hierarchy check (actor must outrank the target, or be root) is enforced per handler and was missing in AdminResetPasskey.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'User List API'. GetAllUsers (GET /api/user/, router/api-router.go:127) passes model.GetAllUsers results straight into the page items with no role filtering or field stripping.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GET /api/user/self/token (GenerateAccessToken) must keep returning the freshly generated token to its owner, and Authorization-header login through ValidateAccessToken must keep working. A fix that nulls or stops persisting AccessToken, or that blocks it at the DB/query layer for every read, breaks both. Admins must also keep seeing the other fields of lower-role users in list/search.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GetSelf builds a hand-written response map; adding "access_token": user.GetAccessToken() there, or in a similar admin 'user detail' map, would bypass the struct tag.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The frontend shows the management token in the profile page, so a maintainer might echo it from GetSelf for convenience. A hand-built map ignores json:"-".

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Caching the full User (rather than UserBase) in Redis and returning the cached object from an admin endpoint.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A performance refactor could swap ToBaseUser() for the full struct. A cache serializer with its own field naming (HSet via reflection, not encoding/json) would ignore the json tag.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An admin CSV/JSON 'export users' endpoint that reuses model.GetAllUsers but marshals through a separate DTO copying all fields.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A user export is a common admin feature request. A copied DTO would carry AccessToken over without the tag.
